deleteDialog.title: Delete fee structure
deleteDialog.sideEffect: Fees already generated from this structure stay exactly as they are — nothing is removed or refunded. The structure just stops applying to future fee generation.
deleteDialog.conflictMessage: This fee structure is still used by a fine rule or an automatic billing rule. Remove it from them first, then delete it.
